subject: gk
question: The term ‘anchor runner’ is related to _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**relay race**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Relay Race

 
 
• In a relay race, the last runner is called the 'anchor'.
 
• Typically, the anchor is the fastest or most experienced competitor in a team.
 
• A relay race is an event where a team of four athletes runs equal predetermined distances in a sprint race, each passing a rod-like object called the 'baton' to the next person to continue the race.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Long Jump__:

 __
 
• In this athletes combine speed, strength, and agility in an attempt to jump as far as possible from a takeoff point.
 
• It is an Olympic event for men since the first Olympics in 1896.
 
 
 
• ​Marathon Race__:
 __
 
• ​__It is a long-distance foot race with a distance of 42.195 kilometers.
 
• It was part of the original modern Olympic events in 1896.
 
 
 
• __​Javelin Throw__:
 
 
• ​In this athletes throw a metal-tipped javelin as far as possible.
